task.title: P6-015: Decide whether the Inbox is renamable and reconcile doc vs server
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 6 — Decisions the maintainer owns). Original id: P6-015. Size: S, decision first. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/collection-api.md, specs/ui-design.md.

**`design/information-architecture.md:37` and the server disagree about renaming the Inbox** — the doc calls it "undeletable, **renamable**", but `hosted.rs:492` still carries `AND NOT is_inbox` on rename, so the API refuses. The UI now follows the server on **two** surfaces (the tree row's menu and the header kebab), so whichever is wrong is cemented twice. Reconcile one: correct the doc, or drop the rename guard.
